class.name: RadioPlayer
class.brief_description: Plays an Icecast/SHOUTcast stream through an audio player node.
class.description: [RadioPlayer] is the simplest way to use the addon. Set [member player_path] to an [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D], call [method play], and the node does the rest: - it opens the connection with its own [RadioStream], - it uses the [RadioDecoder] that the stream creates for the server's content type, - it sets the player's [AudioStreamGenerator] to the stream's sample rate and starts the player, - it feeds the decoder from [method Node._process], - it pauses the player while buffering, and - it reconnects after [member reconnect_delay] when the connection is lost. If the player already has an [AudioStreamGenerator], that one is used, so [code]buffer_length[/code] can be set in the inspector. Otherwise the node creates one with a 2 second buffer. The objects it uses are available through [method get_http_stream], [method get_audio_decoder] and [method get_stream]. The three classes can also be used without this node. [b]Note:[/b] Audio is fed from [method Node._process]. The node must keep processing while the stream is playing (see [member Node.process_mode]).

signal.name: metadata_received
signal.description: Emitted when the server sends stream metadata (needs [member parse_metadata]). [param title] is the value of [code]StreamTitle[/code], usually [code]Artist - Title[/code]. If the metadata has no [code]StreamTitle[/code], the raw metadata string is passed instead.

signal.name: stream_failed
signal.description: Emitted when the connection is lost or could not be opened. [param result] is the [enum RadioStream.Result] and [param http_code] is the HTTP status code, or [code]0[/code] if there was none. The state is already [constant STATE_RECONNECTING] or [constant STATE_FAILED] when this is emitted, so a handler can call [method play] or [method stop] to change what happens next. Not emitted when [method stop] is called.

method.name: play
method.description: Stops the current stream, if any, and connects to [param url]. [param custom_headers] are passed to [method RadioStream.request] (for example a [code]User-Agent[/code] header). Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if [member player_path] does not point to a usable player node, or the error returned by [method RadioStream.request]. Errors that happen later are reported through [signal stream_failed].

method.name: stop
method.description: Closes the connection, stops the player and goes to [constant STATE_IDLE]. Does not reconnect.

method.name: get_home_country
method.description: Returns the two-letter ISO country code of the region set in the operating system, for picking local stations without looking anything up online. On Windows this is the "Country or region" setting, which often differs from the display language. Returns an empty string on other platforms or when no region is set.

method.name: get_stream
method.description: Returns the [AudioStreamGenerator] used to play the audio, or [code]null[/code] before the first [method play].

method.name: get_http_stream
method.description: Returns the [RadioStream] owned by this node. Useful for reading the response headers or the number of downloaded bytes.

method.name: get_audio_decoder
method.description: Returns the decoder of the current connection (for buffering progress or the stream format), or [code]null[/code] when no connection is open.

members.member: Path to the [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D] that plays the stream.
How many seconds of decoded audio must be in the generator before playback starts, or resumes after it ran out of audio. Must be smaller than the generator's [code]buffer_length[/code].

How many seconds to wait before reconnecting after the connection is lost or fails. [code]0[/code] disables reconnecting; the node goes to [constant STATE_FAILED] instead. An unsupported content type never reconnects.
Passed to [method RadioStream.request] as the connect timeout.
If [code]true[/code], stream metadata is requested from the server and reported through [signal metadata_received].

constants.constant: Nothing is playing. [method play] was not called yet, or [method stop] was called.
Waiting for the server to respond.
Connected. The player is paused until [member target_buffer] seconds of audio are buffered.
The connection was lost. A new connection is opened after [member reconnect_delay].
The connection failed and the node will not reconnect (see [signal stream_failed]). Call [method play] to try again.
